prs.title: fix(s2): restore page.css declaration
prs.author: rojoangel
prs.body:
Closes #10873

Restore the empty TypeScript module used to emit the declaration advertised by the `./page.css` export.

The packed-package regression test was removed at the maintainer's request. Its source and before/after validation evidence are preserved locally; the test also remains in commit eaed8d5e3.

## ✅ Pull Request Checklist:

- [x] Included link to corresponding [React Spectrum GitHub Issue](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/issues).
- [ ] Added/updated unit tests and storybook for this change (for new code or code which already has tests).
- [x] Filled out test instructions.
- [ ] Updated documentation (if it already exists for this component).
- [ ] Looked at the Accessibility Practices for this feature - [Aria Practices](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/)
- [x] I understand every change in this PR and can explain why it's there.
- [x] If AI-assisted, I followed our [AI contribution guidance](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#ai-assisted-contributions) and pointed my assistant at [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/blob/main/AGENTS.md).

## 📝 Test Instructions:

Before removing the test:
- `yarn jest packages/@react-spectrum/s2/test/pageCssTypes.test.ts --runInBand` — passed.
- `yarn build` — passed. The built S2 tarball contained both `page.css` and `dist/types/src/page.d.ts`; a strict consumer import with `noUncheckedSideEffectImports` passed. The baseline tarball failed with TS2882.
- `yarn lint` — passed
